Completed all 12 work items. The package now follows SPEC.md across all ten sections, including line-numbered parser errors, last-record-wins deduplication, and calendar-day windows. The audit also corrected group ranking, per-group rate ordering, and conversion streaks.

Updated the README API list and added regression tests, including the requested cases for `None` conversions and duplicate IDs. All 20 tests pass with `python -m pytest -q`.
